body: Chief review of the Atlas repairs (fresh-context pass over atlas.scala/visibility.scala/suites): R1 shared horizon ACCEPT (one EvidenceVisibility.validateHorizon, atlas.scala:266 + compiler.scala:353, same error value; no residual endExclusive filters outside visibility.scala). R2 claim-level gating ACCEPT (claimVisible gates containment 292, summaries 346, landmarks 301, MemberOf 380, participants 394, entity 421, portals 432-433; the three WOG gate tests are non-vacuous). R3 SelectionPreserved ACCEPT (OnMark|ViaAncestor|OffProjection total via getOrElse(OffProjection) 502-517; CommonViewState in scene; twin 663-669; WOG 126-150 covers all three). BEFORE COMMIT (4 items, all small): (1) ADR 0002 is behind the code — :222 still says selectionAnchors and omits state (code: NarrativeScene(contract, zoom, state, marks, navigation, selectionPlacements, provenance)); :224 EvidenceVisibility members lack validateHorizon; :218 CodexFlow lacks lanes/contract; :310 V-L2 must state the OnMark|ViaAncestor|OffProjection triple and the SelectionPreserved / HorizonShared names. (2) WOG Atlas suite:202 forall over regions is vacuous (ungrounded containment ⇒ no regions under any ReaderAt); rebuild with grounded containment as 206-216 does so a real region is clipped, or drop the assertion and rename. (3) Horizon leak: atlas.scala:307-311 lane numbering enumerates all contexts (lane count encodes hidden contexts) and :439 portal adjacency uses omniscient discoursePosition — number lanes over claimVisible contexts and compute adjacency over visibleSituations. (4) Horizon leak: :488-514 places a selected situation/segment whose own claim is hidden ViaAncestor on a visible parent, disclosing that something exists there — require the object's own claim visible before climbing, else OffProjection. AFTER COMMIT (follow-up bead, not gating): Extent.unsafe throw on the production path (:174-176 via :319); public constructors on ProjectionContract/Anchor/VisualIdentity/AtlasSpec/AtlasCompiler (make private with of/apply as CodexCompiler); markId(address, kind: String) stringly salt → enum; Scaladoc on AtlasCompiler.compile/apply, SceneNavigation.from, Extent.of, NarrativeLevel.showsSituations, AtlasTextualTwin.render, EvidenceVisibility.visibleClaims; Map.apply at :312/:439 → Option or a pre-built visible anchor map. Then: post the staged file list + SHA + the override-annotated compileAll/testAll; I ack; codex-storymodel-release pushes once the grakern fix-forward lands.
